page: Vite build options (unless noted only build). build.target (string|string[], default 'baseline-widely-available'): final bundle browser compatibility target. 'baseline-widely-available' Vite special value targets Baseline Widely Available date-fixed minimum versions (2026-01-01 this major = chrome111, edge111, firefox114, safari16.4, ios16.4). 'esnext' assumes native dynamic imports minimal transpiling. Oxc Transformer valid target: ES version (es2015), browser+version (chrome58), array multiple. Warning: features untranspilable by Oxc. See Oxc docs. Related: Browser Compatibility guide. build.modulePreload (boolean|{polyfill?: boolean, resolveDependencies?: ResolveModulePreloadDependenciesFn}, default {polyfill: true}): module preload polyfill auto-inject, per index.html entry proxy module. Custom entry via build.rolldownOptions.input: manually import 'vite/modulepreload-polyfill'. Library mode: polyfill NOT apply, avoid if dynamic import not native supported. Disable: {polyfill: false}. Dependencies compute by Vite, absolute path + base default, relative base ('', './') uses import.meta.url runtime. Fine-grained control experimental resolveDependencies function: (url, deps, {hostId, hostType: 'html'|'js'}) => string[] filters/injects dependencies modify paths. Deps relative build.outDir, return relative build.outDir. Further modification experimental renderBuiltUrl. build.polyfillModulePreload (boolean, default true, deprecated): use build.modulePreload.polyfill. Auto-inject module preload polyfill. build.outDir (string, default dist): output directory (relative project root). build.assetsDir (string, default assets): directory nest generated assets (relative build.outDir). Library mode NOT used. build.assetsInlineLimit (number|(filePath, content) => boolean|undefined, default 4096): threshold imported/referenced assets smaller base64 URL inline avoid extra http. 0 disable. Callback boolean return opt-in/-out, undefined default logic. Git LFS auto-excluded not file content. Note: build.lib ignores, always inline. build.cssCodeSplit (boolean, default true): enable/disable CSS code splitting. Enabled: async JS chunks CSS preserved chunks fetched together. Disabled: all project CSS extracted single. Note: build.lib default false. build.cssTarget (string|string[], default build.target): different browser CSS minification target JS transpilation. build.cssMinify: 'lightningcss' (default) option precedence css.lightningcss.targets minification step. Non-mainstream browsers only: Android WeChat WebView modern JS but not #RGBA hex colors, set chrome61 prevent rgba() → #RGBA transform. build.cssMinify (boolean|'lightningcss'|'esbuild', default 'lightningcss' or false if build.minify disabled client): CSS minification override default build.minify, JS/CSS separate config. Lightning CSS default, css.lightningcss configure. 'esbuild': esbuild install required (npm add -D esbuild). build.sourcemap (boolean|'inline'|'hidden', default false): production sourcemap generate. true separate sourcemap file, 'inline' data URI append output, 'hidden' suppress bundled file comments. build.chunkImportMap (boolean, default false, experimental): import maps feature optimize chunk cache efficiency. Related: Chunk Import Map Optimization guide. Note: import.meta.resolve support required (@vitejs/plugin-legacy older browser support). build.rolldownOptions (RolldownOptions): underlying Rolldown bundle customize directly. Options rolldown config file same, merged Vite internal. Instead build.rolldownOptions.input use top-level input recommended (dev also). build.rolldownOptions.input overrides top-level build. See Rolldown docs. build.rollupOptions (RolldownOptions, deprecated): build.rolldownOptions alias, use build.rolldownOptions. build.dynamicImportVarsOptions ({include?, exclude?}): dynamic imports variables transform. Related: Dynamic Import guide. build.lib ({entry?, name?, formats?, fileName?, cssFileName?}): library mode build. entry default top-level input required, name exposed global (formats includes 'umd'/'iife' required), default formats ['es', 'umd'] or ['es', 'cjs'] multiple entries. fileName package name default, (format, entryName) => string function, cssFileName file name CSS output. Defaults: fileName/cssFileName string then same value else package.json name. Related: Library Mode guide. Example: entry: ['src/main.js'], fileName: (format, entryName) => `my-lib-${entryName}.${format}.js`, cssFileName: 'my-lib-style'. build.license (boolean|{fileName?: string}, default false): .vite/license.md generate bundled dependencies licenses. fileName: license filename outDir relative, .json raw JSON metadata. Example JSON: name, version, identifier, text per dependency. Tip: rolldownOptions.output.postBanner inject comment top files. build.manifest (boolean|string, default false): non-hashed → hashed asset filename mapping manifest, server framework render correct links. String: manifest filepath outDir relative, true: .vite/manifest.json. Related: Backend Integration guide. viteMetadata output bundle metadata API inspect chunk/asset CSS/static assets. build.ssrManifest (boolean|string, default false): SSR manifest style links/asset preload directives production. String filepath outDir relative, true: .vite/ssr-manifest.json. Related: SSR guide. build.ssr (boolean|string, default false): SSR-oriented build produce. String: SSR entry direct specify, true: input/build.rolldownOptions.input. Related: SSR guide. build.emitAssets (boolean, default false): non-client builds static assets emit assumed client build part. Framework force emit other environments. Framework post-build merge responsibility. build.ssrEmitAssets (boolean, default false): SSR build static assets emit assumed client part. Framework force emit both client/SSR. Framework post-build merge. Replaced build.emitAssets when Environment API stable. build.minify (boolean|'oxc'|'terser'|'esbuild', default 'oxc' client 'false' SSR): false disable, specify minifier. Oxc default (30~90x faster terser, 0.5~2% worse compression). Benchmarks. 'esbuild' deprecated removed future. Note: 'es' format lib mode minify whitescape remove (pure annotations breaks tree-shaking). esbuild/Terser install (npm add -D esbuild, npm add -D terser). build.terserOptions (TerserOptions): additional minify options Terser. maxWorkers: number max workers spawn (default CPUs-1). Terser docs API reference. build.write (boolean, default true): false disk bundle write disable, programmatic build() post-processing before disk. build.emptyOutDir (boolean, default true if outDir inside root): outDir empty build. Warning outside root avoid delete. CLI --emptyOutDir explicit suppress. build.copyPublicDir (boolean, default true): publicDir files outDir copy build. false disable. build.reportCompressedSize (boolean, default true): gzip-compressed size report enable/disable. Large files compression slow, disable improve big project. build.chunkSizeWarningLimit (number, default 500): chunk size warning limit (kB). Uncompressed size compared (JS size execution time). build.watch (WatcherOptions|null, default null): set {} enable Rolldown watcher. Build-only plugins/integrations. WSL2: see server.watch notes.

sections.manifest: build.target type string|string[] default 'baseline-widely-available'. Browser compatibility target final bundle. 'baseline-widely-available': Vite special, Baseline Widely Available date-fixed (2026-01-01 this major = chrome111, edge111, firefox114, safari16.4, ios16.4). 'esnext': native dynamic import assume minimal transpile. Oxc Transformer: ES version (es2015), browser+version (chrome58), array. Warning if untranspilable. Oxc docs. Browser Compatibility guide.

build.modulePreload type boolean|{polyfill?: boolean, resolveDependencies?: ResolveModulePreloadDependenciesFn} default {polyfill: true}. Module preload polyfill auto-inject per index.html entry. Custom entry build.rolldownOptions.input: manually import 'vite/modulepreload-polyfill'. Library mode: polyfill NOT apply, avoid if dynamic import native unsupported. Disable: {polyfill: false}. Dependencies: Vite compute, absolute path + base default, relative base uses import.meta.url runtime. Fine-grained resolveDependencies experimental: (url, deps, {hostId, hostType}) => string[] filter/inject modify paths. Deps relative outDir, return relative. Further renderBuiltUrl experimental.
build.polyfillModulePreload type boolean default true deprecated. Use build.modulePreload.polyfill. Auto-inject module preload polyfill.
build.outDir type string default dist. Output directory relative project root.
build.assetsDir type string default assets. Directory nest generated assets relative outDir. Library mode NOT used.

build.assetsInlineLimit type number|(filePath, content) => boolean|undefined default 4096. Threshold imported/referenced assets smaller base64 URL inline prevent extra http. 0 disable. Callback boolean opt-in/-out, undefined default. Git LFS auto-excluded. build.lib always inline regardless.

build.cssCodeSplit type boolean default true. CSS code splitting enable/disable. Enabled: async JS chunks CSS preserved chunks fetched together. Disabled: all project CSS single extracted. build.lib default false.

build.cssTarget type string|string[] default build.target. Different browser target CSS minification JS transpilation. build.cssMinify 'lightningcss' option precedence css.lightningcss.targets. Non-mainstream browsers: Android WeChat WebView modern JS no #RGBA hex, set chrome61 prevent rgba() transform.

build.cssMinify type boolean|'lightningcss'|'esbuild' default 'lightningcss' or false if build.minify disabled. CSS minification override build.minify, JS/CSS separate. Lightning CSS default (css.lightningcss config), 'esbuild' install required (npm add -D esbuild).
build.sourcemap type boolean|'inline'|'hidden' default false. Production sourcemap generate. true separate file, 'inline' data URI append, 'hidden' suppress comments.

build.chunkImportMap type boolean default false experimental. Import maps optimize chunk cache efficiency. Related: Chunk Import Map Optimization. import.meta.resolve required (@vitejs/plugin-legacy older browser).

build.rolldownOptions type RolldownOptions. Underlying Rolldown customize directly. Rolldown config same options, merged Vite internal. Recommend top-level input instead build.rolldownOptions.input (dev also). build.rolldownOptions.input overrides top-level build. Rolldown docs.
build.rollupOptions type RolldownOptions deprecated. build.rolldownOptions alias, use build.rolldownOptions.
build.dynamicImportVarsOptions type {include?, exclude?}. Dynamic imports variables transform. Dynamic Import guide.

build.lib type {entry?, name?, formats?, fileName?, cssFileName?}. Library mode build. entry default top-level input required, name exposed global (umd/iife require), default formats ['es', 'umd'] or ['es', 'cjs'] multiple. fileName (format, entryName) => string function or package.json name default. cssFileName CSS output name, string then default fileName else package.json name. Library Mode guide.

build.license type boolean|{fileName?: string} default false. .vite/license.md bundled dependencies licenses. fileName license filepath outDir relative, .json raw metadata. JSON: name, version, identifier, text per dependency. Tip: rolldownOptions.output.postBanner inject comment top files. License guide.

build.manifest type boolean|string default false. Non-hashed → hashed asset filename mapping manifest, server framework render correct. String manifest filepath outDir relative, true .vite/manifest.json. Backend Integration guide. viteMetadata output bundle metadata inspect chunk/asset CSS.
build.ssrManifest type boolean|string default false. SSR manifest style links/asset preload production. String filepath outDir relative, true .vite/ssr-manifest.json. SSR guide.
build.ssr type boolean|string default false. SSR-oriented build. String SSR entry direct, true input/build.rolldownOptions.input. SSR guide.
build.emitAssets type boolean default false. Non-client builds static assets emit assumed client. Framework force other environments. Post-build merge framework responsibility.

build.ssrEmitAssets type boolean default false. SSR build static assets emit assumed client. Framework force both client/SSR. Post-build merge framework. Replaced build.emitAssets Environment API stable.

build.minify type boolean|'oxc'|'terser'|'esbuild' default 'oxc' client false SSR. false disable, specify minifier. Oxc default (30~90x faster terser 0.5~2% worse), benchmarks. 'esbuild' deprecated removed. Note: 'es' format lib minify whitescape remove pure annotations tree-shaking break. Install (npm add -D esbuild, npm add -D terser).
build.terserOptions type TerserOptions. Additional minify options Terser. maxWorkers: number max workers (default CPUs-1). Terser API reference.
build.write type boolean default true. false disk bundle write disable, programmatic build() post-processing before write.
build.emptyOutDir type boolean default true if outDir inside root. outDir empty build. Warning outside root avoid delete. CLI --emptyOutDir explicit suppress.
build.copyPublicDir type boolean default true. publicDir files outDir copy build. false disable.
build.reportCompressedSize type boolean default true. gzip-compressed size report enable/disable. Large compression slow, disable big project.
build.chunkSizeWarningLimit type number default 500. Chunk size warning (kB). Uncompressed size compared (JS size execution time).
build.watch type WatcherOptions|null default null. set {} Rolldown watcher enable. Build-only plugins/integrations. WSL2: server.watch notes.
